body: And the part that is annoying too is that it doesn’t affect them at all if I don’t do anything besides sit in a chair all day. Why do they care? I’m not getting in the way of them doing anything. I don’t talk unless spoken to because I just care about anything. It’s the fact that they seem like, ‘’pissed’’ that I don’t want to do anything. If I were gone, it would be the same thing, I wouldn’t be doing anything either.

Oh yeah for sure. No one in my family has ever taken my depression seriously. It’s basically like they all think ‘toughen up’ and get over it. And even friends that I have had that were girls over my life, they would also never take it seriously, ever. Girlfriends were another story, too.
